subject: Re: Reranker integration — auth, routing, and eval criteria
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@novacorp.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Reranker integration — initial recap and TODOs

Hi Sara — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment:

Summary of what we heard
- Primary goal: Improve search relevance in product catalog (reduce false positives, boost freshness)
- Expected QPS: ~20 req/s for candidate generation, peak bursts to 120 req/s during campaigns
- Latency target for ranked results: P95 < 150ms
- Data constraints: customer PII must not be logged in hosted service; want optional Private deployment in Q4 if pilot is successful

Technical questions we flagged
1) Auth: you asked about API key vs mTLS for service-to-service calls — we can support both; need confirmation which you prefer for the pilot
2) Routing & model variants: do you expect routing by tenant / quality tier? (e.g., coarse model for low-cost traffic, high-quality reranker for payment pages)
3) Embeddings & candidate store: are you planning to host a vector DB (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus) or would you use our managed embeddings + caching?
4) Eval metrics: suggested initial metrics are NDCG@10, MRR, and a manual relevance set of ~200 queries — confirm acceptance

Action items (owners + suggested cadence)
- Aditya: provide an integration checklist + sample SDK snippets (attached) — by EOD today
- NovaCorp (Sara): share infra diagram and whether you can enable mTLS or need API-key flow — by EOD Thu 5/6
- Redwood (Laura/Rishi): propose a minimal reranker evaluation plan and signal matrix for relevance — draft by Fri 5/7

Attachments: MVP-integration-checklist.csv (small checklist), redwood-sdk-snippets.zip (examples for node/python)

Thanks — I suggest a 30m sync next week once you share the infra diagram.

—
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: aditya@redwood.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reranker integration — initial recap and TODOs

Aditya — quick internal note before we send the checklist to NovaCorp. A couple of technical clarifications we should include in the eval plan:

- Top_k tuning: recommend we propose k candidates = [20, 50, 100] for the initial sweep and measure NDCG@10 and response latency across those buckets. Capture median per-token cost for each k so they can weigh cost vs quality.
- Relevance signals: explicit clicks + add-to-cart are strong implicit signals for their flow; propose a blended label where CTR weight=0.6, add_to_cart=0.4 for initial model score calibration.
- Cold-start: suggest adding a synthetic augmentation set (50 queries) to ensure the reranker doesn't overfit sparse product categories.

Also, add a short note on auth: if they pick mTLS we'll provide sample cert rotation steps; API key flow will be standard header + scoped key. Which one they pick will determine sample code we attach.

If you want I can draft the signal matrix and a 1-page eval rubric; I'll aim for a Friday draft.

Laura
Director, Solutions Engineering
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@novacorp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: eng_infra@novacorp.com, matt@acme-ml.com
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reranker integration — initial recap and TODOs

Thanks for the recap, Aditya — this is helpful. A few answers and clarifications from our side:

- Auth: we prefer mTLS for service-to-service calls (security team requirement). We'll need guidance for cert rotation; we can provide a wildcard cert for the pilot but will want rotation instructions.
- Routing: initially all tenant traffic goes to a single quality tier. If the pilot shows improvements we'll route high-value segments to a higher-quality reranker. For now, single-routing is fine.
- Candidate store: we host an internal Milvus cluster and can accept embeddings; we'd prefer Redwood to return reorder scores only (i.e., we do candidate generation + pass top-k embeddings to Redwood).
- Eval: NDCG@10 + MRR sounds good. We also ask for a simple human-graded relevance sample — we'll provide ~250 labeled queries over the next two weeks.

Questions for Redwood:
1) When you say 'reorder scores only', what's the API payload shape? Will the SDK support batched score calls (vector batch -> scores)?
2) What top_k max can your reranker accept in one call and what latency scaling should we expect?
3) Any constraints on feature vectors (dimensionality, normalization)?

We'll attach our infra diagram by Thursday 5/6. Happy to take a short sync next week after you update the checklist.

Sara
Head of Search, NovaCorp
sara.patel@novacorp.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@novacorp.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, matt@acme-ml.com
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reranker integration — initial recap and TODOs

Great — thanks Sara, that's exactly the clarity we needed. Short answers inline and next steps: 

Answers:
1) API shape: we support a batched score API where payload = { request_id, candidates: [{id, embedding}], metadata } and response = [{id, score, latency_ms}]. The SDK wraps batching (Node/Python) so you can send up to 128 embeddings per RPC; internally we stream and shard for low latency. I'll include the exact JSON schema in the next message.
2) top_k: for reorder-only calls we recommend k <= 200. Practical latency guidance: k=20 typically P95 ~ 40-60ms, k=50 P95 ~ 70-110ms, k=100 P95 ~ 140-220ms depending on sequence length and model. We'll include measured numbers once we test with NovaCorp sample.
3) Embedding constraints: support any float32 vector; recommended dims = 256 or 768 (we auto-normalize if you set normalize=true). Avoid sparse encoded features in the same vector — pass them as separate metadata fields.

Next steps (owners):
- Redwood (Aditya): send SDK payload schema + cert rotation guide (mTLS) and updated checklist with top_k guidance — by EOD today (attached: redwood-sdk-snippets.zip)
- NovaCorp (Sara): infra diagram + labeled relevance sample (~250) — by Thu 5/6 and Mon 5/10 respectively
- Redwood (Laura/Rishi): draft eval rubric (NDCG@10, MRR) + signal matrix + suggested k sweep — by Fri 5/7

Proposed sync: 30m on Mon 5/10 at 9am PT to review infra and handshake details. Adding a tentative calendar link here: https://cal.example.com/meet/rdw-nova-5-10

If you want, Laura and I can run a quick pre-check on the Milvus embedding shape once you send the diagram.

Thanks — attaching the SDK snippets and checklist again.

—
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
